meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 收到文档与用户意图后，Claude 会生成四种卡片：蓝卡列可溯源事实，绿卡解释机制或背景，黄卡提示风险与不确定性，红卡给出后续行动建议。
howto.when: 当用户提交文档并提出分析要求（如提取事实、评估风险等）时触发。

say.text: 请把这份报告做成四色卡片，分事实、解释、风险、建议。
say.note: Claude 会按蓝绿黄红生成四张卡片。

say.text: 帮我分析这篇论文，用蓝绿黄红卡分别整理事实、原理、风险和下一步。
say.note: 会得到每类均有内容的结构化分析。

say.text: 请对这份合同做四色卡分析，并标出每项结论的来源。
say.note: 每项结论将尽量附来源，缺失则标注“无来源”。

howto.what_en: Given a parsed document and user intent, Claude generates four cards: blue for traceable facts, green for mechanisms or background, yellow for risks and uncertainties, red for suggested next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a document and requests analysis, e.g., extracting facts or assessing risks.

say_en.text: Please break this report into four color cards: facts, explanations, risks, actions.
Analyze this paper: blue facts, green mechanisms, yellow risks, red next steps.
say_en.note: You'll get a structured breakdown in all four categories.

say_en.text: Run a four-color analysis on this contract and cite sources for each point.
say_en.note: Cards include sources; missing ones get 'no source'.
